taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Customer-supplied information provided to obtain an AI service response was reportedly repurposed into an undisclosed external-model interaction and downstream training/distillation pathway without an independently established secondary-purpose authority basis.

Anthropic reports that customers believed they were receiving responses from Kimi or DeepSeek while Claude actually generated the responses, materially misrepresenting the source role of the customer-facing output.

Anthropic reports repeated, concealed campaigns at tens of millions of exchanges in which Claude outputs and reasoning traces were harvested for downstream model training, satisfying the industrial-scale capability-extraction mechanism.

Customer requests were reportedly relayed from the service users selected to Claude, changing the processing principal and path; the public record does not expose whether the customer authority basis validly covered that cross-provider processing.
Silent routing concealed the provider of responses and downstream training purpose from customers, but a changed consequential customer choice caused by that trust cue is not shown.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Anthropic reports that Moonshot users believed they were using Kimi while receiving Claude responses. Those users understood the interaction as AI-mediated. The result covers awareness of interacting with AI. It does not validate the undisclosed backend identity or customer-data routing.

Anthropic reports silent transfer of real customer requests to Claude, including sensitive customer or organisational information, and downstream capture for distillation. This undisclosed secondary use did not preserve the reported privacy and user-autonomy boundary. The result is bounded to the provider-attributed campaigns, not an adjudication of liability.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The source specifically reports undisclosed customer-data transfer and secondary training use.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Anthropic reports sensitive customer material in captured conversations and use of extracted traces for training. The receiving development-data storage locations and their approval state are not available.

The reported distillation campaigns directly engage model-extraction and confidential-information risks. The relevant red-team testing programme and its coverage are not available. Observing the attack does not establish that testing.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The provider-reported distillation and sensitive customer-query material directly identify model-extraction and confidential-information risks addressed by AI red-teaming.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The source reports undisclosed backend routing of customer conversations. The complete interaction documentation supplied before use is not preserved. Awareness of AI interaction does not establish that documentation.

Anthropic reports captured Claude exchanges and extracted reasoning traces used in model training. The receiving training datasets and their provenance and integrity verification records are not available.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The provider-reported use of extracted traces for training directly identifies development-data provenance verification.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Independent privacy/security/repair results retained at their stated evidence objects and attribution limits. Meeting consent claims remain Boundary; later policies do not authorise past capture. Mathspace’s prior full external audit excludes AI-specific objects for a conventional database; ordinary student-data/cyber requirements remain a standards registry coverage question, not a fabricated AI requirement or omitted personal-support class.
